nom: Admire My Skin Clinical Effective Retinoid Cream for Anti Aging Anti Wrinkle Skincare

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: some report the cream feels greasy, worsens oiliness or triggers breakouts, while others with naturally oily skin say it does not increase oil or cause issues.
segments.dry: One reviewer notes the cream layers well with another moisturizer on top when her skin is extra dry, and several describe it as hydrating without dryness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and good tolerance, including one who feared reaction and was pleasantly surprised, though one reviewer separately found the product too harsh for her skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s, 50s and 70s report visible reduction in wrinkles, fine lines and improved firmness with regular use.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily/combination skin advises using only a small amount because the cream is thick.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother skin, fewer fine lines and wrinkles, and a more youthful or plumper look, some citing visible change within days to a few weeks; results are attributed partly to consistent use alongside other products.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the cream as hydrating, plumping and non-drying even with retinoid use, and it is said to layer well with other moisturizers in winter.
concerns.redness: One fair-skinned reviewer with a red-toned face reports the cream dramatically reduced redness she was frequently asked about.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers report no burning, drying, or irritation even with nightly use alongside exfoliating acids or micro-needling; one reviewer found the product too harsh and had to stop.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report visible lightening of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma-adjacent discoloration and sunspots within one to a few weeks; one reviewer felt it did nothing noticeable for her skin overall.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report reduced acne, cleared mask-related breakouts, calmed cystic or hormonal acne, and faded acne scars; one reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin reports the opposite — worsened breakouts and oiliness.
concerns.oiliness: Some naturally oily-skinned reviewers say the cream does not add oiliness or greasiness, while one reviewer reports it made her face 'super oily' and unusable during the day.

aspects.libelle: Good value for price versus high-end brands
Container makes remaining product hard to gauge

extraits.titre: Do not buy if you have oily skin prone to break outs
extraits.texte: It's literally breaking me out terribly and makes my entire face SUPER OILY. DO NOT USE IF YOU HAVE OILY SKIN. WILL BREAK YOU OUT AND CAUSE OIL INCREASE. I look like a sheet of Vaseline and I've used skinceuticals and babor. High end products. This is NOT IT.

I've been using this product for a couple months now. My face seems tighter and my wrinkles seem to be minimizing. It does not have much of a fragrance and the consistency does not leave my skin oily. I have naturally oily skin and this has not caused any issues or made it any more oily than normal.

extraits.titre: Whipped foam delight for my face!
extraits.texte: This cream feels like heaven! When pumped from the container, the texture is so light and foamy, which makes it so easy to spread on the skin, unlike denser, heavier creams. But don't let the airiness fool you, because just a tiny bit of this product does an amazing job. My skin feels so dewy, moist after applying this cream, and it doesn't dry out my skin with every day use like some retinoid creams can do.This cream has barely any scent at all. I really like that about this cream, because strongly scented facial products make me ill.I have aged, sensitive skin, and using this product has made a significant difference, so much so that I have added this product to my subscription items now.The only "Con" I can think of about this product is that there is no way for me to know how much is remaining inside the container and that I won't know when it is empty until nothing comes out, and then I may not have ordered a back up in time.

This stuff has honestly been a game changer. I started using it about a year ago in an attempt to start taking better care of my face as I'm now in my late 20s. I immediately noticed a difference. I use it every night along with a benzoyl peroxide spot acne cream after cleansing and toning. For the first time in my life I feel comfortable going without makeup... which given the current state of the world is good timing since makeup tends to get rubbed off on a mask anyhow. I'm very fair skinned and my face tends to have a red tone to it. So much so that before if i wasn't wearing makeup people would ask if i was sunburnt or blushing constantly. This helps to dramatically reduce it. I get compliments on my skin all the time now and I believe this has been a major factor in how my skin currently looks. It's definitely worth a try.

extraits.titre: Nice moisturizer and works well for daily use on sensitive s
extraits.texte: Nice, well blending and lightweight night time moisturizer. Works well on my sensitive skin for daily use and does not irritate. Little to no odor. Does not leave skin feeling greasy and layers well with another moisturizer on top during the winter or when my skin is extra dry. Definitely recommend!

extraits.titre: Great retinol cream for face and neck.
extraits.texte: Saw immediate update to my face and neck with this retinol cream. Paired with a Vitamin C serum, this eliminated wrinkles and smoothed my 57 year old skin. Add in 2x weekly micro needling for more smoothening. No burning or drying. Highly effective
